Class ClientSlotAddressing

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.window.ClientSlotAddressing
@Internal public final class ClientSlotAddressing extends Object
The single client-side "live slot → Address" mapping that every client slot-observer shares — observed reactions (ObservedReactions) and slot interaction signals (WindowSignals). MK-alone the default addresses vanilla slots only (VanillaAddressing); MKC installs the kind-aware SlotAddresses.of so a created slot resolves to its created address. One install point, one resolution rule, so two observers can never disagree on which address a slot has.

Internal plumbing. Both ends are library-owned: MKC install(ClientSlotAddressing.SlotAddressFn)s its kind-aware rule and MK's client observers addressOf(AbstractContainerMenu, Slot) live slots through it. Consumers address slots by Address; they neither install nor call this directly.
